statement.text:
Let π be a set of primes. We say that a finite group is a BSπ -group if every
conjugacy class in this group any two elements of which generate a π-subgroup itself
generates a π-subgroup. Is every normal subgroup of a BSπ -group a BSπ -group?
    In the case 2 ̸∈ π, an affirmative answer follows from (D. O. Revin, Siberian Math.
J., 52, no. 2 (2011), 340–347).                                             D. O. Revin
